title: Integration tests: 3-part reassembly, out-of-order, error cases, CRC32
description:
Comprehensive test suite. Oracle: known byte patterns with known ranges. No round-trip self-tests.

Depends on: MIME-j5n.4 (add_part + finish complete)

Tests:
1. 3-part in-order: [0..100), [100..200), [200..300) of known bytes; finish() == correct buffer
2. 3-part out-of-order (3,1,2): same result
3. Single-part covering whole file
4. Missing part: is_complete()=false, missing_ranges()=[100..200), finish()=Err(Incomplete)
5. Overlapping: Err(OverlappingPart)
6. Out-of-range part: Err(OutOfRange)
7. CRC32 mismatch: Err(CrcMismatch) with correct expected/actual fields
8. CRC32 correct: Ok
9. TruncatedPart: data shorter than claimed range

CRC32 oracle: compute crc32fast::hash() of the known pattern independently; hardcode as constant.
Acceptance: cargo test -p yencoding-multi passes, zero self-referential oracles
close_reason: 23 tests: 3-part in-order, out-of-order, missing part, dup rejection, CRC mismatch, zero-byte, sweep.
